text:
1. 16. 4. 7. 

Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ. Atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ. Evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savaṇāya. Atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye na labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savaṇāya.
